rag.text:
Test: TC-580 — Box Module - Teams - Duplicate team
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Automated
Folder: /BP/TS-112 Box Module - Teams
Labels: be-enterprise, can_be_automated, rocksolid

Steps:
1. Navigate to Teams module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-580 Box Module - Teams - Duplicate team
   Expected: Teams module is displayed

Wizard menu appeared with 3 tiles:

* Create new 
* Assign existing 
* Duplicate & edit existing
2. Select Duplicate & edit existing tile
   Expected: Modal window 'Duplicate existing Teams' is displayed. 

Fields to duplicate team appears:

* Teams selector
* Cancel button
* Duplicate button (greyed out)
3. Click Cancel button
   Expected: Additional fields to duplicate team disappeared.
4. Select Duplicate & edit existing tile
   Expected: Modal window is displayed. Fields to duplicate team appears:

* Teams selector
* Cancel button
* Duplicate button (greyed out)
5. Click on Teams selector and select teamName
   Data: teamName: TC-580 Team to duplicate
   Expected: Upper level team is selected
6. Click Duplicate button
   Expected: Upper-level team is duplicated. "TC-580 Team to duplicate" is displayed on the screen
7. Click on Plus button dropdown menu
   Expected: Following options appeared on the list:

* Create new team
* Create new team based on Jira Team
* Create new team based on Jira group
* Assign existing teams
* Duplicate existing teams
8. Select Duplicate existing teams
   Expected: Modal window is displayed. Fields to duplicate team appears:

* Teams selector
* Cancel button
* Duplicate button (greyed out)
9. Click on Teams selector and select teamName and click Duplicate
   Data: teamName: TC-580 Team to duplicate
   Expected: Team TC-580 Team to duplicate is not visible on the list
